seepers.configuration.title: Seepers Settings
seepers.configuration.verboseLogging.too: Log extra diagnostic messages from Seepers systems.
seepers.configuration.logNetwork.tooltip: Log Seepers packets received by the client.
seepers.configuration.debugCommands.tool: Enable /seepers debug commands for operators (permission level 2).
seepers.configuration.darkness.tooltip: True darkness (applied on clients; set by the server)
seepers.configuration.blackLightLevel.to: Light levels up to this value render completely black. Visible radius of a light source = its level - this - 1.
seepers.configuration.maxGamma.tooltip: Upper limit for the Brightness (gamma) video option: 0.0 = Moody, 1.0 = Bright.
seepers.configuration.nightVisionBrighte: If off, the Night Vision effect still exists but does not brighten the world.
seepers.configuration.disableNaturalHost: Block natural spawning of hostile mobs (also patrols and phantoms). Exceptions: entity tag #seepers:natural_spawn_exempt.

commands.seepers.debug.storage.dimension: Dimension %s: active chunks %s (this one: %s), lidar points %s from %s sources
commands.seepers.debug.storage.global: World: full base copies %s, remains %s, players with lives %s; your lives %s, current tag %s
